answer: Underwriter bond stops mass fake identities. Each agent holds one policy for one orchard plot: its underwriter locks a 100-credit ferrous reserve and charges 35 each epoch. Each epoch, 5% face a yarrow audit: auditors re-run the harvest log; a fake plot burns its policy and reserve; rented underwriters fail. 1,000 fakes cost 35,000 an epoch plus 100,000 locked against a 40,000 pool, a net loss. An honest agent pays 35 once and keeps its share.
